reviewMethod: All 145 steps in 28 group-seven lessons checked with real audio, manual continuation, letter help at 320/390/1366 pixels, eu/ui combinations, wrong answers, repeated-letter choices, Kijk nog eens, jump/recovery and within-group continuation. 57 representative previous-group steps and the latest landing page at five widths passed again. limitations: Browser emulation, no physical phone or learner pilot.
